Tens of thousands of Salvadoran Marylanders are feeling anxious and uncertain about their future today because of the Trump-Vance Administration.

For more than 25 years, they have been a vital part of our community — caring for seniors, building homes, tending farms, and making this state stronger. 

I join business, faith, and community leaders in urging the Trump Administration to swiftly extend their Temporary Protected Status and give these families the stability they deserve.

Today, we announced two major actions to support the workers who keep @BWI_Airport running:

1) I've directed @MarylandDOT to make sure that no airport worker under a direct contract with the Maryland Aviation Administration is paid less than $18 an hour, and

2) We’re conducting a new study with @salisburyuniversity to get a real picture of wages, benefits, and retention at BWI.

If BWI is going to compete, it has to compete for workers too.
